Meta AI reports that, after fitting more than 1,000 loss observations, its loop-scaling law predicted held-out loss better than linear and power-law mappings.

In a compute-matched trillion-token test, Meta AI’s law-selected 0.3B-active/1.3B-total MoE matched the 0.6B-active/2.9B-total baseline on BBH and GSM8K, but scored 46.9 versus 50.2 across 14 benchmarks and used more inference compute.
